# Warning codes

<!-- Generated by `brainstem-nwb mapping --warnings` (scripts/generate_docs.py); do not edit by hand. -->

Every warning in a manifest has one of these codes. Severity: `error` means the unit cannot be produced or would be wrong; `warning` means information was lost or a placeholder was used; `info` is an expected gap.

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `BEHAVIOR_NO_TIMING` | info | A behavior is linked to no epoch, so it has no times; it is described in the notes. |
| `DATA_MODEL_CACHED` | warning | The BrainSTEM server could not be reached, so the data model was read from the copy cached the last time it was; records changed on the server since then may be described incompletely. |
| `DATA_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED` | warning | The server's data model generation is not one this release was written for; fields it does not know are kept in the manifest, but links may be missed. Update brainstem-nwb. |
| `DEVICE_MANUFACTURER_UNKNOWN` | info | Supplier records are not in the export, so no NWB DeviceModel (which requires a manufacturer) is written; the hardware device name is in the Device description. |
| `ELECTRODES_NOT_WRITTEN` | info | Electrode (channel) rows are written only with raw data (Phase 4); metadata-only files have electrode groups but no electrodes table. |
| `ELECTRODE_GROUP_LABELS_UNATTRIBUTABLE` | info | The acquisition defines electrode groups but uses several electrophysiology interfaces, so the groups cannot be assigned to one device; one ElectrodeGroup per interface is written. |
| `EPOCH_NEGATIVE_TIME` | warning | An epoch starts before the session start time; it is written with a negative start time. |
| `EPOCH_STOP_BEFORE_START` | error | An epoch ends before it starts; it is not written. |
| `EPOCH_TIMES_MISSING` | warning | An epoch has no start or end; it is not written to the epochs table. |
| `EXPERIMENTER_NOT_AVAILABLE` | info | No experimenter: BrainSTEM sessions do not record who ran them and user names are not exported. Set nwbfile.experimenter in the configuration file. |
| `EXPORT_MINOR_NEWER` | info | The export is a newer minor format version than this release knows; unknown labels and fields are kept in the manifest and otherwise ignored. |
| `FILENAME_COLLISION` | warning | Two units would get the same file name; a short BrainSTEM id was appended. |
| `ICEPHYS_NOT_MAPPED` | info | Intracellular recordings are described in data_collection; NWB intracellular electrodes are written only with raw data. |
| `IDENTIFIER_SLASH_REPLACED` | warning | A subject or session name contains '/', which breaks NWB and DANDI paths; it was replaced by '-' in subject_id or session_id (the original name is in the manifest). |
| `IMAGING_PLANE_NOT_CREATED` | info | Imaging acquisitions are described in data_collection; an NWB ImagingPlane needs the indicator and imaging rate, which are not recorded, so none is written. |
| `LAB_NOT_AVAILABLE` | info | No lab or institution: they are not in the export. Set nwbfile.lab and nwbfile.institution in the configuration file. |
| `LEGACY_BARE_NUMBER` | warning | A value saved under an older schema has no unit in the export; it is written as 'unit not recorded'. |
| `LOCALIZATION_INCOMPLETE` | warning | Coordinates lack a value or a unit for one of the three axes; the record is not localized. |
| `LOCALIZATION_NOT_SUPPORTED` | info | Coordinates in this system are not a 3D point in a space (e.g. a brain-surface entry point with an insertion depth) or the space is not supported yet; they are kept in the ndx-brainstem tables only. |
| `MULTIPLE_SUBJECTS` | info | The session has several subjects; one NWB file is written per subject. |
| `NO_SUBJECT` | error | The session has no subject (or specimen set with a subject); run with --allow-no-subject to export it without one. |
| `NO_SUBJECT_ALLOWED` | warning | The session has no subject and was exported without an NWB Subject. |
| `NO_TRIALS` | info | BrainSTEM has no trial records; no trials table is written. |
| `OPTO_SITE_NO_WAVELENGTH` | warning | An optic fiber is used for optogenetic stimulation but no wavelength is recorded; NWB requires one, so no OptogeneticStimulusSite is written. |
| `OPTO_SITE_WAVELENGTH_AMBIGUOUS` | warning | An optic fiber is used with several wavelengths; NWB allows one per site, so no OptogeneticStimulusSite is written. |
| `OUTPUT_EXISTS` | error | A different NWB file already exists at the output path; use --overwrite to replace it. |
| `PROCEDURE_AFTER_SESSION` | info | A procedure of the subject happened after the session; it is left out of the NWB file and kept in the manifest. |
| `PROCEDURE_DATE_UNKNOWN` | info | A procedure of the subject has no date; it is treated as having happened before the session. |
| `PROCEDURE_NOT_PERFORMED` | info | A procedure or specimen procedure is planned or cancelled, not performed; it is left out of the NWB file and kept in the manifest. |
| `PROCEDURE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED` | warning | A procedure type is not in this release's vocabulary; it is described in the notes. |
| `PUBLICATIONS_NOT_RESOLVED` | info | The project has publications, but publication records are not in the export; their ids are in the manifest. |
| `RECORD_SHARED_ACROSS_SUBJECTS` | warning | A record of a multi-subject session is not linked to any subject, so it is included in the file of every subject. |
| `REGION_NOT_RESOLVED` | info | A target brain region is not recorded, or its region record is not in the export (format 2.0 exports hold no region records); the NWB location is 'unknown' and region ids are kept in the manifest. |
| `RESTRICTED_LAB_RESOURCES` | info | The records reference lab resources (equipment, setups, protocols, ...) the exporting user cannot read; only their names are exported, and they are named in the text fields and the manifest. |
| `SCHEMA_NOT_AVAILABLE` | warning | A BrainSTEM JSON schema version the records use could not be fetched; its URL is in the file, the schema itself is not embedded. Another version is never used instead. |
| `SESSION_DESCRIPTION_MISSING` | warning | The session has no description; a placeholder naming the session was written. |
| `SESSION_NOT_PERFORMED` | info | The session is planned or cancelled, not performed; no NWB file is written for it. |
| `SESSION_START_TIME_MISSING` | error | The session has no date and time; NWB requires a session start time, so no file is written. |
| `SPECIES_IRI_UNAVAILABLE` | warning | species_format is 'ncbitaxon' but the species record names no NCBI Taxonomy id; the binomial name was written. |
| `SUBJECTS_INFERRED` | warning | The session lists no subjects; they were taken from its behaviors, procedures and interfaces. |
| `SUBJECT_AGE_NEGATIVE` | error | The subject's birth date is after the session start; age is not written. |
| `SUBJECT_AGE_UNKNOWN` | warning | The subject has no birth date, so neither date_of_birth nor age is written. |
| `SUBJECT_NOT_IN_EXPORT` | error | The session lists a subject that is not in this project's export (it belongs to another project). |
| `SUBJECT_SEX_UNKNOWN` | info | The subject's sex is recorded as unknown; NWB sex is 'U'. |
| `SUBJECT_SPECIES_MISSING` | warning | The subject's species record is not in the export. |
| `SUBJECT_WEIGHT_NOT_IN_EXPORT` | info | Subject weight comes from subject log entries, and this export has none for the subject (format 2.0 exports hold no log entries). |
| `SUBJECT_WEIGHT_UNKNOWN` | info | The subject has no Weighing or Monitoring log entry with a weight at or before the session start. |
| `UNIT_FAILED` | error | Building or writing the unit failed; see the message. |
| `UNKNOWN_FIELD` | info | A record has a field this release does not know; it is kept in the manifest. |
| `UNKNOWN_LABEL` | info | The export contains a record type this release does not know. |
| `UNMAPPED_FIELDS` | info | Some BrainSTEM fields have no NWB destination; they are kept in the manifest. |
